newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar off, July breaks support.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar off, July breaks support.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were lower in brisk midday trade on Tuesday as speculative selling pressured the benchmark July contract below its downside target, floor sources said.

The spot month ran into sell stops under support at 11.37 cents, where a double-bottom had formed on the charts on June 9 and June 6. The contract slipped to the day's low of 11.32 cents, where trade buying in the July and in the July/October spread stymied further losses.
Dealers expect prices to continue to ease ahead of July's expiry on June 30, however.
"It may be holding now, but it still looks heavy," a trader said.
The July/October spread stood at 0.14 cent, where it closed on Monday.

At 1135 EDT, the benchmark July contract eased 0.09 cent to 11.36 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.41 to 11.32 cents. October was down 0.09 to 11.22, while the outer months stood 0.04 to 0.10 weaker.
Volume was estimated at 18,066 lots as of 1100 EDT.
Friday's July options expiry is expect to speed speculative rolling of the July contract, traders said, pegging support between 11.20-11.00 cents.
Open interest in the front month stood at 75,732 lots, down 2,686 lots as of early Monday. Second-position October gained 2,159 lots to 65,512 lots.
